The no-code input actions path visibly demonstrates gesture and virtual-control input, survives save/reload, and fails with an actionable diagnostic when a required capability is unavailable.

actions.action: Repeat the workflow in English, German, and Chinese at 1024×640 through 3840×2160 and 80–200% UI scale.
actions.expected: Text, controls, canvases, popovers, focus order, and scrolling remain contained and keyboard reachable.
